First listed 2026-03-06 · episode or wrap

Iran War Volatility, Private Credit Fears Grow, & Solar Continues to Crash | The Weekly Wrap

Eisman attributes market swings to changing war and credit narratives, flags retail and institutional redemption pressure, and remains cautious on solar and health insurance. The Elevance regulatory problem was real, but the threatened sanctions were conditional and later recorded as corrected. He explicitly leaves AI-driven mass unemployment and life-insurer credit losses unproven. His categorical no-credit-cycle-since-GFC statement is too broad; evidence of market anxiety is distinct from realized systemic loss.
